import.pasteDescription: Plain text, ChordPro, or OpenLyrics — the format is detected automatically. Blank lines separate sections; lines like "Verse 1" or "Chorus" become labelled sections.
import.communityDescription: Paste a public repository URL (e.g. a GitHub link like github.com/owner/worship-songs) or a direct .zip link. Every recognised song file inside — OnSong, ChordPro, OpenLyrics, OpenSong, CCLI — is imported.

import.noPacks: No songs found in the selected pack(s)
import.noPackSongs: No songs found in that pack
import.nothingToImport: Nothing to import — paste some lyrics first
